messages:
alex_h: CI canary image publish is red on the final push step — getting `unexpected EOF` / partial layer write. Failed on 3/5 canaries. Seen right after a Dockerfile change that copies vendor/ into image. cc @maya @jamal

maya: can you paste the failing job id and a short log snippet?

alex_h: job `canary-build/5678` log excerpt:
```
INFO[0000] pushing layer sha256:abcdef12345
WARN[0001] wrote 238912 bytes, expected 262144
error writing blob: unexpected EOF
http error: 502 Bad Gateway
```

jamal: hmm could be registry multipart / S3 upload truncation or kaniko chunking bug. Do we see proxy timeouts? ops-bot, any ingress spikes?

ops-bot: @eng-infra saw a small S3 504 spike at 2026-03-15T14:12:xxZ that lines up with two of the failures. No large-scale outage but increased 502/504 for ~2m.

alex_h: filing a quick rerun now, but this has been flaky across commits. Requesting a bisect if reruns continue.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex_h — queued as `canary-build/5678-rerun-1`.

maya: if it reproduces, can you try a `--no-cache` rerun or set chunk size env var for kaniko (KANIKO_CHUNK_SIZE=4M) to see if it avoids truncation? Also try a local `docker build && docker push` from CI runner to rule out builder vs registry.

alex_h: starting rerun with `KANIKO_CHUNK_SIZE=4M` env. will report back.

ci-bot: Rerun started: `canary-build/5678-rerun-1` (triggered by alex_h).

ops-bot: I pulled registry logs for the original failure: we saw an aborted multipart upload from the CDN edge, then backend returned 502. Looks like a transient write failure on a backend shard.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: success on one canary, failure on another — flaky.

sara: given flaky success/failure pattern I'd prefer a bisect. If it started after the Dockerfile COPY change (vendor => vendor/ with glob), bisect between commit `a1b2c3d` and `d4e5f6g`. Also consider changing COPY step to `ADD repo.tar.gz /app/vendor` as a workaround (fewer small files).

jamal: agree. Also check builder image version — we recently bumped kaniko vX.Y.Z in CI image two weeks ago. Try pinning to previous kaniko image to see if it changes behaviour.

alex_h: ok I'll open a bisect request and attach CI links + build ids. If ops can keep an eye on S3 shard for retries that would help. Going to try local docker push from a runner as an immediate probe.

maya: if we confirm registry-side truncation, eng-infra ops can add a retry wrapper in the publish step (retry 5 with backoff) to mask transient S3 errors while we bisect root cause.

jamal: +1 on retry wrapper and bisect. If bisect fast-forwards to the kaniko bump, we'll pin back and then work a proper fix.

alex_h: thanks everyone — opening bisect now and assigning to eng-infra. Will paste the bisect thread here once created. :thumbsup:
